decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher stays close to the core postpress portfolio and fits existing distribution and service routines, and with growing industry turnover there is no performance shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core offer and its results are still uncertain, but it is a flagship with a German premiere, and slack from growing turnover lets the firm carry it while it builds a track record.
The sheet preparation module builds on the modular systems and supports sales of complete finishing lines, so it costs little to carry and fits the strategy.
The B2 multifinisher is a home-page flagship close to the core business that matches the push toward automated workflows, so it very likely meets aspirations.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the established booklet-making demand and existing service capabilities, so there is little pressure to drop it.
The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation with the Touchline line, which shows results in line with aspirations.
